rule: Use only props/events listed in registry/packages/platformscode-core@<installed version>.json. Unknown version → run tools/extract_package_api.py first. Never claim official DGA status for these packages (NOT VERIFIED).

@platformscode/core.role: Stencil web components (custom elements) — the real implementation

0.0.52.validated: Button (196-record baseline), Button+Dropdown+icons in React, Angular (custom elements), vanilla, ExB-simulation

0.1.45.events: React prop = on + Stencil event name (onOnClick)
0.1.45.bundle: imports all 123 components + global core.css (~4.1 MB JS)

why: DgaButton wrapper exposes only variant/size/disabled/text — 'text' is not a prop of dga-button in core 0.0.17 or 0.0.52 (label is)
module does not define the custom elements; logs status to console on startup
2.0.0.instead: Angular 19 + @platformscode/core@0.0.52 custom elements with CUSTOM_ELEMENTS_SCHEMA + lib/angular (tested)

0.0.11.import: named imports from the package index work in Vite and Angular (tree-shaken)

4.3.5.import: prefer deep default imports: import Tick02Icon from '@hugeicons/core-free-icons/Tick02Icon' (index import ran esbuild out of memory in the Angular build)

DgaButton.props: variant size label disabled type iconOnly iconType iconProps leadIcon leadIconType leadIconProps trailIcon trailIconType trailIconProps onColor sx btnId

DgaButtonV2.props: variant size label disabled destructive type iconOnly leadIcon leadIconProps trailIcon trailIconProps onColor btnId

DgaDropdown.props: label placeholder options optionLabel(name) trackBy(value) value multiSelect size(md|lg) variant(default|lighter|darker) error disabled readonly leadingIcon onChange getSelectedOptions sx extraClass id
notes: onChange is a PROP callback (value) not a DOM event
options objects need {name, value} by default

DgaIcon.props: name variant(stroke|solid…) type(rounded|sharp|standard) size color flipRtl src icon lazy sanitize
notes: data URLs must be raw 'data:image/svg+xml;utf8,<svg…>' (URI-encoded fails)
arrow/chevron names auto-mirror in RTL unless flipRtl:false

defects.summary: peer @platformscode/core 0.0.17 → ERESOLVE with 0.0.52; wrapper inputs do not match core API ('text' vs label); elements not defined by the module
defects.workaround: use core custom elements directly (lib/angular)

defects.summary: importing named icons from the package index made esbuild run out of memory (5 GB) in the Angular build
defects.evidence: dmesg OOM kill during ng build; fixed by deep default imports (build 12-14 s)
defects.workaround: deep default imports

defects.summary: :host { width: fit-content } — footer does not fill the page unless the host is sized by the page
defects.workaround: host-level CSS only:.ah-footer > dga-footer { width: 100% } (lib/patterns/patterns.css); no inner restyle

defects.summary: section.footer-content has a 434px minimum width → horizontal page scroll at 390px in LTR (RTL clips it) — 5.0.2: also in RTL once groupLinks render (NavLinks=true): 25px page scroll at 390
defects.workaround: host-level:.ah-footer { max-width:100%; overflow-x:auto } ≤480px (the footer band scrolls, not the page); content stays reachable

defects.summary: mainImage renders an /link with no alt / accessible-name prop
defects.workaround: pass a logo only together with a descriptive mainLinkTilte; otherwise omit the image

defects.summary: iconType / icon prop printed as raw text instead of rendering an icon
defects.workaround: icon={false}; put icons outside the link

defects.summary: featuredIcon prop printed as raw text
defects.workaround: showFeaturedIcon={false}

defects.summary: change indicator value is hard-coded: Math.abs(100) + '%' — always shows '100%' with a trend arrow regardless of data
defects.workaround: showInfo={false} so no invented trend is displayed; also min-width 360px on the host — use grid minmax(min(100%,360px),1fr)

defects.summary: search button (.dga-search-box__search-btn) has no accessible name → axe button-name critical
defects.evidence: AXE on every page with a search box
defects.workaround: none from outside the shadow root; DGA Exact cannot be claimed while present

defects.summary: menu list markup: <li> rendered by dga-nav-header-link is not a direct child of the <ul> (custom element in between) → axe list / listitem serious
defects.workaround: none from outside the components

defects.summary: card title heading level is fixed (h4) — cannot follow the page outline
defects.workaround: keep an h2/h3 above each card grid (SectionHeading) so the outline has no skips

defects.summary: host shrink-wraps to content width (Figma Card = fill container)
defects.workaround: host-level CSS:.ah-cards dga-card { display:block; width:100% }

defects.summary: LTR variant link text (.digital_link) fails colour contrast (axe color-contrast serious); dga-icon inside has role=img without a name
defects.workaround: none from outside

defects.summary: label rendered without for/id association to the <textarea> (shadow DOM) → axe label critical
defects.workaround: none from outside the shadow root

defects.summary: close button (.dga-btn--close) has no accessible name → axe button-name critical
defects.workaround: hide the close button when the alert is informational (if the prop exists in the project's version) or accept the DEVIATION

defects.summary: title heading levels are fixed (inline alert h4, list title h3)
defects.workaround: keep an h2 above them so the outline stays h1→h2→h3→h4

defects.summary: radio border colour #6c727e is not in dga-tokens.json/css (package light DOM)
defects.workaround: none; counted separately from page-authored colours

defects.summary: header row 60px vs Figma Accordion Large header 56px
defects.workaround: none; DEVIATION

defects.summary: defaultExpanded item: body max-height computed before layout (48px) is smaller than the content (56px) → clipped text (reproduced in vanilla + Angular, not in React)
defects.workaround: toggle the item after componentOnReady instead of defaultExpanded, or accept the clip; not a CSS recreation

defects.summary: `title` prop is declared in the component API (string, optional) but never rendered; the visible heading (h4.alert__title) is `leadText` and the body is `helperText`
defects.evidence: @platformscode/core 0.0.52 dist/components/dga-inline-alert.js — render uses this.leadText / this.helperText only; this.title is unused (found while QA LANDMARKS flagged the body text rendered as the h4)
defects.workaround: pass the heading as `leadText` and the body as `helperText`; never rely on `title`

defects.summary: importing a single React wrapper (e.g. DgaButtonV2) pulls the whole component set into the bundle: 4.03 MB raw / ~598 KB gzip JS for one button (React alone: 46 KB gzip). The wrapper entry registers every custom element eagerly, so tree-shaking cannot remove unused components.
defects.evidence: measurement: scratch Vite app React 18 + `import { DgaButtonV2 } from "platformscode-new-react"` → dist JS 4,032.6 kB / gzip 597.9 kB; same app without the import → gzip 45.7 kB. Vanilla apps using `@platformscode/core/components/<tag>.js` defineCustomElement per tag: 221 KB gzip.
defects.workaround: for strict budgets register only the used tags from `@platformscode/core/components/<tag>.js` (vanilla/Angular path) and use the custom elements directly; otherwise accept and document the vendor floor; code-split routes so the vendor chunk is cached once

defects.summary: an item rendered with defaultExpanded=true can never be collapsed: componentDidRender re-assigns isOpen = defaultExpanded after every render, undoing handleAccordionClick (mouse, Enter and Space all fail)
defects.evidence: @platformscode/core 0.0.52 dist/components/dga-accordion.js handleAccordionClick/componentDidRender; reproduced by the keyboard gate (K1) and a mouse click on examples/government-site #/ar/faq
defects.workaround: do not use defaultExpanded; render all items collapsed (DEVIATION from frames that show the first item open) — also avoids PKG-ACCORDION-02

defects.summary: native input is not programmatically labelled (axe `label`), the `error` state does not set aria-invalid and the helper/error text is not linked with aria-describedby
defects.workaround: add the label/description outside only if the package exposes no hook; otherwise report — do not patch shadow DOM. FormPattern shows an error summary (role=alert) so errors are still announced

defects.summary: tabs render as <a> items without role=tablist/tab/aria-selected; Arrow keys do not move between tabs and Enter on a focused tab does not activate it (mouse click works)
defects.workaround: for keyboard-critical tab UIs use a page-authored tablist following the APG pattern or link-based navigation; record as DEVIATION in Exact

defects.summary: dialog is opened with the `open` attribute (not showModal): no focus move into the dialog, no focus trap, no accessible name (aria-labelledby), Escape does not close it
defects.workaround: manage focus in the host app (move focus to the dialog title on open, return it on close) and close on Escape from a host keydown listener; keep it opt-in and documented

defects.summary: `featuredIconProps` is optional in the typings but render reads its fields → TypeError "reading 'name'" when omitted
defects.workaround: always pass featuredIconProps { size, color, variant }

defects.summary: no role=alert/status and no live region — the only role inside is the icon (img); alerts inserted later are not announced
defects.workaround: wrap dynamic alerts in an aria-live region (AlertStack / FormPattern already do)

defects.summary: variant 'dots-only' never renders dots: childrenLength is read from the slides container, which dots-only does not render (always 0)
defects.evidence: 5.0.2 Home template rebuild, package source dist/components/*.js (dga-carousel.js updateChildrenLength / render)
defects.workaround: use variant='dots' with real slides (one slide visible, dots below); each slide must be a full-width element

defects.summary: no change/slide events and no slide aria (role/label) — slide position is not announced
defects.evidence: 5.0.2 Home template rebuild, package source dist/components/*.js
defects.workaround: label each slide (role=group, aria-label 'n / total') and the region (aria-roledescription); report in a11y QA (lib/core/carousel-a11y.js adds inert/aria-hidden to off-screen slides)

defects.summary: groupLinks are not rendered unless NavLinks=true (undocumented boolean)
defects.evidence: 5.0.2 Home template rebuild, package source dist/components/*.js (dga-footer.js render)
defects.workaround: pass NavLinks={groups.length > 0} (SiteFooter / siteFooter do)

defects.summary: renders only the named slots card-content and card-actions; un-slotted children are not displayed; the host has a fixed 360 px width, so cards overflow a narrower grid cell
defects.evidence: 5.0.2 Home template rebuild, package source dist/components/*.js (dga-card-v2.js render)
defects.workaround: slot='card-content' / slot='card-actions' on the children, and width:100% on the host inside a grid (ServiceCarousel / serviceCarousel + patterns.css do)

defects.summary: ≤600 px the actions are replaced by a '…' button whose menu lists hard-coded placeholder items ('Item 1', 'Item 2' …) — the real header actions (e.g. sign in) are unreachable on mobile
defects.evidence: 5.0.2 Home template rebuild (QA engine run; package source dist/components)
defects.workaround: none from outside the component; report; offer sign-in elsewhere on mobile pages if required

defects.summary: slide width is measured once (componentDidLoad / slotchange) — no resize handling; off-screen slides keep focusable controls
defects.evidence: 5.0.2 Home template rebuild (QA engine run; package source dist/components)
defects.workaround: lib/core/carousel-a11y.js enhanceDgaCarousel: inert + aria-hidden on off-screen slides, re-slot on resize to trigger the component's own re-measure

defects.summary: bottomImages (partner / platform logos, Figma footer 'Logos') render without alt and there is no alt prop — axe image-alt (critical)
defects.evidence: 5.0.2 QA engine: image-alt 1 → 2 nodes when two logos were passed
defects.workaround: do not pass bottomImages until the package adds alt text; if logos are mandatory, report the deviation

defects.summary: width / maxWidth / minWidth are copied into cardStyles once, in the constructor — before any framework sets them — so the inner card keeps its default 360 px and never fills a wider cell (and overflows a narrower one)
defects.evidence: 5.0.2 Service / Services templates, package source dist/components/*.js
defects.workaround: stretchCardV2(host) (lib/core/carousel-a11y.js) sets the inner.card to 100 % after hydration; used by ServiceCard / serviceCard / CommentsCard

defects.summary: handleInitValue builds selectedFilters with `undefined` entries for every filter type missing from `initvalue` (typed optional) and render then calls block.items.map → TypeError; without initvalue it throws on `'checkbox' in undefined`. Supplying slider/range blocks to avoid the crash shows them as selected chips
defects.evidence: 5.0.2 Service / Services templates, package source dist/components/*.js
defects.workaround: FilterMenu / filterMenu: Neutral Large DGA button + panel of dga-checkbox / dga-radio-button (Figma Filtration anatomy)

defects.summary: the <li> row has a fixed height of 24 px, so a step that wraps to two lines overlaps the next one (Figma lets long steps take 48 px)
defects.evidence: 5.0.2 Service / Services templates, package source dist/components/*.js
defects.workaround: patterns.css:.ah-steps dga-list-item > li { height: auto }

defects.summary: the horizontal tab list never wraps or scrolls; three medium tabs with icons overflow a 390 px viewport (horizontal page scroll in LTR)
defects.evidence: 5.0.2 Service / Services templates, package source dist/components/*.js
defects.workaround: patterns.css:.ah-svc-tabs.dga-tabs-list { overflow-x: auto }

defects.summary: content items and actions never wrap or collapse — at < 600 px the bar overflows the viewport (the Figma mobile templates drop the Second Nav Header)
defects.evidence: 5.0.2 Service / Services templates, package source dist/components/*.js
defects.workaround: patterns.css hides dga-second-nav-header below 600 px, as in the Figma mobile frames

defects.summary: --colors-neutral-500 (text-secondary-paragraph) is #6c727e in core.css; the DGA Figma variable is #6c737f — page text using the token is off-palette by one step (E3)
defects.evidence: 5.0.2 Service / Services templates, package source dist/components/*.js
defects.workaround: none — the token is kept (correct semantics); E3 attributes the drift

defects.summary: the logos and actions slots are stretched to equal widths so the menu is centred — a wide gap opens between the logo and the first menu item; Figma (Header Content = SPACE_BETWEEN [Logo & Menu Items, gap 16] … [Actions]) and live DGA-aligned portals keep the menu next to the logo and push the actions to the far end
defects.evidence: header screenshot vs a live DGA-aligned portal; measured: dga-nav-header-logos 421 px wide around a 160 px logo at 1440 (core 0.0.52)
defects.workaround: patterns.css: logos/menu hug their content, actions margin-inline-start:auto (light-DOM host rules, no package patch)

frameworkPitfalls: Angular: camelCase DGA props must be PROPERTY bindings ([leadIconType]="'x'"); a static attribute leadIconType="x" does not reach the Stencil prop (observed: angular-results-run1-static-attribute-pitfall.json)
React 18 / ExB: JSX on custom elements sets attributes — objects/arrays (leadIconProps, options) must be set as DOM properties (lib/exb DgaElement); platformscode-new-react wrappers already do this
Stencil events: listen to 'onClick' (DOM event name) — React wrapper prop onOnClick
